answer: Each new agent identity must post a bond that grows quadratically: identity n locks n²×0.001 ETH for 30 epochs, so 100 sybils cost ~5 ETH. Bonds are slashed if an attestation quorum of 7 peers flags hollow behavior (fake work outputs). A vouching terrace limits each real peer to endorsing at most 3 new identities per epoch, and endorsed pearls—identities earning >10 completed contracts—grant vouchers that decay 20% per epoch.
